title: The X-Men Were Rescuing Their Friends. The Island Wanted Seconds.
description: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975), original Second Genesis account. Later Deadly Genesis retcons are outside this short. A connected, source-reviewed illustrated recap with the central reversal reserved for the final act.
hook: An island captured the X-Men. Cyclops escaped, and brought it a second team.
payoff: Xavier needed strangers to save his students. They came back as the new X-Men. For more stories like this, subscribe.

units.onscreen: THE RESCUE TEAM IS ALSO THE BAIT
units.visual_query: THE RESCUE TEAM IS ALSO THE BAIT

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In Giant-Size X-Men number one, from 1975, Professor Xavier recruits new mutants to rescue his missing students.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Storm, Wolverine and Nightcrawler join the rescue. They barely know each other, and Krakoa's jungle fights back.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: They find the missing team trapped inside. The monster isn't hiding on the island. It is the island.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Krakoa feeds on mutant energy. It let Cyclops escape so he'd bring back more food. The rescue was another delivery.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The captives are freed, but attacks can't defeat a whole landmass. Xavier tells them to combine their powers.
units.onscreen: THEY NEED TO FIGHT AS ONE
units.visual_query: THEY NEED TO FIGHT AS ONE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Storm charges Polaris with lightning. Cyclops and Havok add their blasts, until Polaris can hurl Krakoa off the planet.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The island leaves a deadly whirlpool. The mutants escape together, rescuers and rescued now one team.
units.onscreen: THEY STILL HAVE TO GET AWAY
